Before you begin

A few things
worth knowing.

No signals. No broker connection. No promise of trading profits.

How is Still different from a trading course or journal?

Still is built around daily practice, not just watching lessons or recording past trades. You get a clear task, work through it, and build something you can use again—such as a preparation checklist, a research routine or your own Rules Card. The programme connects these steps into a guided 56-day journey.

Who is Still for?

Still is for adult retail traders who want a more deliberate way to prepare, research, practise and review. It is especially relevant if you understand the basics but struggle with FOMO, impulsive trades or following your own plan. You do not need to be a professional trader, but Still is not a complete beginner-to-expert course in how to trade.

Which trading markets does Still support?

Still is for traders across all markets—including stocks, forex, crypto, futures, options and commodities. The programme focuses on how you prepare, make decisions and review your process, rather than recommending particular assets. You apply the exercises to the market you trade; Still does not provide live market feeds, trade signals or a strategy for every instrument.

Do I need to make real trades—or trade every day?

No. No quest requires a real-money trade. You can practise using historical examples, paper trading and reflection. The programme also works on days when your market is closed or you choose not to trade. Progress comes from completing the practice, not from placing more trades.

How much time should I set aside?

Plan for around 20–25 minutes for the main quest and daily routine on a typical day. Some exercises take longer, and optional life habits add time. Shorter versions are planned for busy days, with an estimated time shown for each quest so you know what to expect.

What happens if I miss a day?

You do not lose the work you have already completed or have to start the programme again. Still is designed to help you return with a manageable recovery task and continue your path. The aim is to build a routine you can return to—not punish you for an imperfect streak.

Do I need to connect my trading account?

No. Still does not connect to your broker or exchange, place orders, or require your trading-account password or API keys. When an exercise involves your market or trading history, you can review it yourself without importing it into Still. Progress is based on what you choose to record, not automatic verification of your trades.

When can I start, and how do I pay?

Still is being built for iPhone first. Join the founder list for launch updates and details of the founder offer. Joining is free. At launch, the 56-day programme is planned as a one-time in-app purchase, with the price shown before you pay. There is no payment on this website.
